title: Caltex Australia Petroleum Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of assets from Milemaker Petroleum

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Process Guidelines.
Former provisional decision date of 16 February 2017 delayed due to delays in receiving information from the parties.
Former proposed decision date of 2 March 2017 delayed to allow the parties to provide additional information.
Former proposed decision date of 3 March 2017 delayed to allow the parties to provide additional information.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.
Closing date for submissions relating to Statement of Issues.
Former proposed decision date of 20 April 2017 delayed to allow the ACCC to consider additional information provided by the parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

During the course of the review the ACCC also made a number of document and information requests to Caltex and Milemaker that are not separately identified in the entries above. Collectively, the parties took 70 business days to respond to these other requests.

body_sections.Summary: Caltex proposes to acquire certain assets relating to 46 retail service stations in Victoria from Milemaker Petroleum.
body_sections.Market definition: Please refer to the Public Competition Assessment.
